Jonathan's Space Report
No. 860                                                                   2026 Oct 1    Bromley, UK
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Update:
-------

Construction on my new Space Library near London is now well under way.
The books are scheduled to arrive on Tuesday!
Updates at https://www.gofundme.com/f/fund-jonathans-space-report-library-transition
(further donations welcome)

ISS
----

Expedition 75 is underway.

On Sep 1 Adenot and Meir, in suits 3003 and 3015, carried out US EVA-99.
They replaced a planar retroreflector antenna on IDA-2, and replaced an EHDC camera at CP3.
They also installed some cables, obtained samples from the ISS exterior to test for
microorganisms, and performed some prep work for maintenance of the AMS experiment.
Depressurization to repressurization was 1231 to 1929 UTC.

Cygnus NG-24 performed an orbit raising burn of 1.2m/s on Aug 27 at 1653 UTC.
Another burn of 1.0m/s was made on Sep 25 at about 1543 UTC.

Progress MS-33 undocked from the Poisk module at 1518 UTC Sep 7 and was deorbited at 1827 UTC
with entry over the South Pacific at around 1909 UTC.

The Progress MS-35 cargo ship was launched on Sep 16 and docked with the Poisk module at 1344 UTC Sep 19.

Dragon Grace C213.2 was launched on Oct 1 on the Crew-13 mission, carrying Jessica Watkins,
Luke Delaney, Joshua Kutryk, and Sergey Teteryantnikov.
